Disables the vanilla bump animation between NPCs and other human characters while preserving normal collision. Zombie collisions are unchanged.

Requires LLM Conversations. Typed requests can direct faction members to fetch, deliver, move, work, fight, or drive. Game code validates every action. Persistent changes and bulk transfers require a typed yes/no confirmation. Single-player/host only. Disabled by default.

Optional typed NPC conversations. Before launching PZ, open ProjectRemnantsSetup.exe, choose a provider and model on the LLM Companion tab, then click Configure and Start. Keep the app running while playing. When disabled, no LLM systems run.
Allows delivered LLM conversations to shape hidden personal trust, warmth, respect, fear, and memories. Requires LLM Conversations. It never changes factions, orders, jobs, combat, or party state.
